items.q: Do I need any technical knowledge?
items.a: None at all. You describe how you work today; we handle everything technical and hand you systems that simply run, with clear documentation and simple dashboards.
Yes. We can self-host everything on your own servers or a private instance, use managed credentials (never hardcoded secrets), and follow least-access principles. Your data stays yours.
It depends on scope, so we quote after the free audit. Most small-business automations are a one-time setup plus a small monthly fee for hosting and maintenance — and they pay for themselves quickly.
Simple automations ship in days; larger systems in a few weeks. You get a clear timeline with your quote, and we deliver in stages so you see value early.

items.q: Will it work with my current tools?
items.a: Almost certainly. We connect the tools you already use — CRM, spreadsheets, WhatsApp, email, e-commerce, accounting, and hundreds of others — no need to switch anything.
Every system is built with retries, fallbacks, and error alerts, so we're notified before you are. Maintenance is included in the monthly plan.
